decision: Exclude the unreferenced structured-assembly macro library from the selected core build and retain it under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file defines an optimizing structured assembly macro library.
The only exact references in retained core sources are comments in parse.asm stating that its include and macro use were removed.
The frozen selected dependency inventory contains no struc.inc include edge; bios/biostruc.inc is a separate file and remains untouched.
limitations: Exclusion applies to the selected three-component build only; other DOS sources may use the library.
